finding: For N=513 on 128 ranks, ceil(N/P)=5 assigns empty ranks 103 through 127 startRow>N, while endRow is clamped to N. The unsigned subtraction endRow-startRow underflows, and its product with N converts to negative MPI send/receive counts. MPI_Gatherv also receives pointers beyond the allocated matrix on those ranks.
observed_failure: MPI_Gatherv reports MPI_ERR_COUNT: invalid count argument; execution exits 2 before validation or result output. The paired program passes.
interpretation: Pre-existing empty-partition handling defect independent of concurrent scheduling. Retain failed external validation without retry.
investigation: Static inspection of the source and retained MPI diagnostic; no new program execution.
